what: Hook scripts reference paths relative to the aide-v0 project root (scripts/hooks/recall-for-path.js uses __dirname to find project root). When hooks run from a DIFFERENT project directory (like /tmp/aide-val), the scripts can't find the MemoryStore dist files because __dirname points to aide-v0, not the test project. The hooks need to operate on the CURRENT project's memories, not aide-v0's. This is why Read hooks don't fire in test projects — recall-for-path.js opens the wrong store.
why: Hooks still not firing in test project despite init creating settings.json. The absolute paths in settings.json correctly point to the script files, but the scripts themselves use __dirname-relative logic to find the project root, which resolves to aide-v0 not the test project.
